Two segregated ABC spot/perp venues with repeated finite-life carry and several funding boundaries

bounded_implementation_tasks.scope: Composable one-book scenario assembly with no forced derivative population
bounded_implementation_tasks.acceptance: An integrated fixture builds exactly one ABC/USD book and the declared roster; historical multivenue defaults remain unchanged.

bounded_implementation_tasks.scope: Finite seed-once opening orders, no refill or price anchor
bounded_implementation_tasks.acceptance: After either seed order fills, no replacement arrives; seed account balances and depth contribution reconcile.

bounded_implementation_tasks.scope: Equal-resource shared quote lifecycle and hard worst-case position cap for pure and AS makers
bounded_implementation_tasks.acceptance: Simultaneous live, pending and cancel-in-flight orders cannot breach the declared cap; identical target quotes do not create asymmetric churn; post-only and fee paths are matched.

bounded_implementation_tasks.scope: Delivered-past AS variance/fill exposure prior, account/PnL/observation reconstruction
bounded_implementation_tasks.acceptance: No decision reads future or venue-global state; formula agrees with normalized-inventory fixture; missing, duplicate, reordered, fee-wrong and incomplete evidence fail closed.

bounded_implementation_tasks.scope: Two venue-local spot/perp rosters and equal OFF/ON carry slots
bounded_implementation_tasks.acceptance: Each venue has independent cash/base/perp collateral, actors receive only venue-local delayed data, OFF retains endowed idle accounts and equal background IDs.

bounded_implementation_tasks.scope: Versioned compressed funding with local averaging, phase, sub-bp precision and remainder
bounded_implementation_tasks.acceptance: 5/8-minute clocks and +60-second phase hit exact scheduled times; the 60 timestamped t-60s..t-1s local samples and t-minus eligible position exclude same-time orders; rate and transfer arithmetic, conservation, cap, missing mark, skip-without-catch-up, overflow and repeated subunit accrual pass independent fixtures.

bounded_implementation_tasks.scope: Post-warmup recurrent finite-life term carry and independent payment/exit evidence
bounded_implementation_tasks.acceptance: A desk can enter, receive several actual funding transfers, unwind both legs and re-enter; partial legs, failed settlement and terminal residual remain separately reconstructible.

planning_review.scope: Two read-only, source-grounded design/readiness questions: E0 roster and E2 compressed funding/carry. No world, code change, pinned executable protocol or empirical claim was reviewed.
planning_review.retention: Conversational feedback from the earlier planning turn, not a retained signed review or review of the exact completed documents.
planning_review.e0_conclusion: Defensible question; not ready for execution. Requires shared pending-inclusive cap, one-book equal-resource assembly, finite seed, common quote lifecycle and arm-neutral evidence.
planning_review.e2_conclusion: Plausible question; compressed matched funding comparison not ready. Requires versioned interval scaling/precision/window, lifecycle-bearing term actor, equal OFF/ON accounts and payment coverage.
